title: ChunkContext
description: A contextual-retrieval situating context: the 50–100 tokens an LLM prepends to one chunk so the chunk stays interpretable outside its document. Invalidation invariant: the record is keyed by docHash — ANY change to the source document changes docHash and invalidates every ChunkContext carrying the old digest, forcing incremental regeneration rather than silent staleness. Index targets form a closed set (embedding, bm25) — BM25, not TF-IDF, per the published method this hardens. Generation provenance is digest-pinned (which model wrote the context) because contexts are model output and must remain attributable; scope honesty: contextual retrieval fixes chunk AMBIGUITY, not a corpus that lacks answer-facts.

specVersion.description: Epistemic-kernel contract version, pinned. Changing this const is a contract change.

docRef.description: URN or stable reference of the source document.

docHash.description: Content digest of the source document version this context was generated from. The invalidation key.

chunkId.description: Stable identifier of the chunk within the document version.

chunkHash.description: Content digest of the chunk text itself.

contextText.description: The situating context prepended to the chunk before indexing. Bounded to keep contexts context-sized, not summaries.

items.description: An index this context+chunk pair is written to.

indexTargets.description: Closed set of destination indexes. Dual-indexing (embedding AND bm25) is the published method's shape; rank fusion and reranking live in the consumer, not this record.

modelDigest.description: Content digest of the model artifact when available.

promptCacheKey.description: Cache key of the shared document prefix, when prompt caching was used to amortize per-chunk generation cost.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 date-time the context was generated.
